title: Unbounded Node.js stream or request-body accumulation
preconditions: remote request or stream chunks are appended to persistent buffers/arrays
multiple consumers or retries retain chunks beyond request lifetime
dangerous_transitions: each attacker-controlled chunk increases retained memory without a cumulative cap
slow consumers prevent release while producers continue
sink_semantics: body parsers, message queues, and per-request chunk arrays
counterevidence: A byte/count cap is enforced before append and overflow terminates or backpressures the producer.
verification_recipe: Trace chunk production, buffering, consumption, cancellation, and cleanup.
Measure retained bytes under bounded and over-limit streams with a negative control.
Check per-connection and aggregate concurrency limits.
